title: kit.monitor-delivery.v1
description: One row of monitor_deliveries: one message through one route in one run, written by the runner (recordDelivery) and read by the status document (routes). The kinds are fixed here, not in a migration comment (applied migrations are append-only): canary, the daily proof of a route; drill, an alert drill's marked message (POST /run?mode=drill); alert, journeys failed; route-failure, another route did not deliver; deadman-failure, the dead-man ping failed.
